race.comment: COOL AZ ALETTA (5) returns and will find this a fair bit easier than the opposition he found out the back end of last prep. The form around him last prep reads favourably for this and an inside draw should see him land handy. Can play a major role. TESORINO (9) showed good early dash last time out and led for most of the way before being claimed and finishing a nose away in third over 1100m at Gilgandra. Will take catching. SON OF EUREKA (11) hit the frame two starts ago at Tamworth but ran below par last time when sixth at Bathurst after being in contention on the bend. Gets the blinkers on first time and finds a nice race to turn things around. OUR EMILY (3) made a nice return two back then met with solid backing but disappointed when seventh over 1100m at Gilgandra three weeks ago. Rates highly and is in the mix. ELASUVI (6) boasts a first-up win and gets an important 2kg claim. Not dismissing fresh.
